newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid debt offering raised to $1.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid debt offering raised to $1.0 bln.

text.p: Rite Aid Corp's multi-tranche debt offering was increased to $1.0 billion from an initial $600 million to meet investor demand for the paper, according to corporate bond syndicate sources.
"The deal was boosted to $1.0 billion to meet strong demand for the paper," one high-grade syndicate source said.
-Price talk on the $350 million five-year tranche issue is in the area of 50 to 55 basis points over Treasuries.
-Price talk on the $350 million 10-year issue is seen in the area of 70 to 75 basis points.
-Price talk on the $300 million 30-year issue is in the area of 100 to 105 basis points.
The deal, which is expected to price via Goldman Sachs & Co later today, is rated A3/BBB-plus, sources said.
